name: Lasso Freight
description: Walk a tug through a bright loading yard, laying a rope route that snags loose cargo onto receiving pads.
natural_language: Route the tug carefully: loop the rope around every crate and certify all three pads.

metadata.notes: A self-contained, tile-based bridge inspired by Cyber Lasso: the visible rope path, legal snag rule, browser hit testing and exported replay all share one discrete transition contract.
